Pakistan increases bounty on Masood Azhar ahead of FATF review

Pakistan has increased the bounty on Jaish-e-Mohammed chief Masood Azhar to PKR 70 lakh. Azhar is listed in a new Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) Red Book, which includes 19 individuals linked to the 2008 Mumbai attacks. This action comes ahead of a Financial Action Task Force (FATF) review.
